scientific_integrity: The exact local valuation formula is specialized explicitly to the three multiplicative-order classes modulo \(5\), the \(\nu_5=1\) refinement is reduced to mod-\(25\) conditions, and the density argument uses only the classical divergence of reciprocal primes in the class \(4\bmod5\). Finite computation is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specialized to \(p=5\). The density-one conclusion has no quantitative error term. The full text of the 2025 follow-up was not available through the consulted lawful sources, leaving a residual literature-coverage risk.
title: Exact \(5\)-divisibility criterion for the sum-of-divisors function
